ResearchProjectDef.label: local radio
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build VHF and UHF hand-held radios and a base station, so colonists out of sight can still reach home. Every contact is decided by a real link budget: power, antennas, walls, rock and noise.

ResearchProjectDef.label: software radio
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the radio terminal: a computer driving a software-defined radio, with a far quieter receiver than the desk.

ResearchProjectDef.label: linear amplifiers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a linear amplifier for a station's coax: up to 100 watts out, for the antennas whose cable runs through it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high-power amplifiers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the heavy linear amplifier: up to 400 watts out, at four times the draw and heat.
